title: MatCore record, standard version 0.7.0
description: A MatCore metadata record in JSON, generated from the standard (decision record 0078).

items.description: A primary entity (e.g. person, organization, software agent) responsible for creating the dataset's core content and their institutional affiliation if relevant.

formula.description: The chemical formula of the material component.

value.description: A value of the variable.

form.description: The geometric form of the component as modeled.

role.description: The part the component plays in the structure.

value.description: The value of the property.

items.description: A phase of the material.

microstructure.description: For a solid state phase, a description of the arrangement of phases, grains and defects in the material.

items.description: A group of calculations in the dataset that share one method and one set of settings, e.g. the DFT single points of a training set.

label.description: A name for this computation, by which other computations and the method-specific sections refer to it.

task.description: What the calculations of this computation do.

conditions.description: The conditions imposed on the simulated system during the computation, e.g. by a thermostat, a barostat, a loading device or a fixed simulation cell. Omitted when no condition is imposed, e.g. for a single point or a training computation.

spatial-uniformity.description: How the imposed conditions vary across the system.

description.description: Explanatory text clarifying the simulation type, and how any condition varies in space or time, e.g. a temperature ramp, a thermostat applied to part of the system, or a composition set by chemical potentials. For a condition that varies, it states how, e.g. the shape of a ramp or the region a value applies to.

gw-self-consistency.description: Specifies the level of iterative updating applied to the Green's function (*G*) and the screened Coulomb interaction (*W*) in the GW calculation. This property identifies whether the GW equations are solved in a 'one-shot' perturbative manner or through an iterative cycle where the quasiparticle states are updated to reach a self-consistent solution.

bse-self-consistency.description: Specifies the level of iterative updating applied to the excitonic Hamiltonian in the BSE calculation. This property identifies whether the BSE is solved in a 'one-shot' manner or through an iterative cycle where the excitonic states are updated to reach a self-consistent solution.

dielectric-matrix.description: Information on the dielectric matrix used to compute the screened Coulomb interaction *W*.

planewave-basis-cutoff.description: For a planewave code, the basis set cutoff employed for the dielectric matrix. It is set separately from the cutoff of the wave functions (dft kinetic-energy-cutoff) and is usually lower.

frequency.description: The method used to handle the frequency dependence of the Green's function, the screened Coulomb interaction, and their product.

response-basis-size.description: For sum-over-states methods, the number of bands used in the sum. For linear-response methods, the number of dielectric eigenvalues.

band-terminator.description: The method used to approximate the contribution of the bands left out of the sum over states of the polarizability.

q-points.description: Brillouin zone grid used for sampling the dielectric matrix.

coulomb-truncation.description: Method used to eliminate long-range Coulomb interactions between periodic replicas in supercell calculations.

self-energy.description: The settings of the GW self-energy and the bands it corrects.

band-range.description: The first and last band whose quasiparticle energies are computed. Bands are numbered from 1, the lowest band in the calculation.

number-of-bands.description: The number of bands in the sum over states of the self-energy, which runs over bands 1 to number-of-bands. It is at least the last band of band-range.

band-terminator.description: The method used to approximate the contribution of the bands left out of the sum over states of the self-energy.

bse-hamiltonian.description: A collective descriptor for the parameters defining the construction, dimensionality, and solution method of the effective excitonic Bethe-Salpeter Hamiltonian that is being solved in a BSE calculation. It characterizes the Hilbert space size and the physical constraints (momentum and spin) applied during the diagonalization.

number-valence-bands.description: Number of valence bands included in the BSE Hamiltonian.

number-conduction-bands.description: Number of conduction bands included in the BSE Hamiltonian.

k-point-mesh.description: Brillouin zone grid used for building the BSE Hamiltonian.

exciton-momentum.description: Crystal momentum of the exciton in the BSE calculation.

exciton-multiplicity.description: Specification whether the BSE calculation is performed for singlet or triplet excitons.

diagonalization.description: Approximation method used to diagonalize the BSE Hamiltonian.

number-lowest-eigenvalues.description: Number of lowest eigenvalues computed by solving the BSE Hamiltonian.

bse-kernel-truncation.description: Method used to eliminate long-range Coulomb interactions between periodic replicas in the BSE Coulomb kernel.
